div.div: 8 ارتصف It had its several parts put, or joined, together, or together and in regular order; as also ↓ ترصّف , [or this means it had its several parts well put, or joined, together, &c., (see 2, of which it is the quasi-pass.,)] and ↓ تراصف . (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
